name: Extensor Tendinopathy of Foot and Ankle
tags: extensor tendinopathy of foot and ankle
definition: Overuse irritation of extensor tendons across the anterior ankle and dorsum of the foot, often related to repetitive dorsiflexion or footwear pressure.

typical: Pain with resisted toe or ankle extension

investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, cartilage, tendon, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Persistent focal pain requires reassessment for occult stress injury.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada-Snayu overuse phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Overuse irritation of extensor tendons across the anterior ankle and dorsum of the foot, often related to repetitive dorsiflexion or footwear pressure.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, severe deformity, progressive weakness, suspected tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
